lines.speaker: dock_foreman
lines.text: You're not union, you're not customs, and you're not lost, because lost people look at the water. So what are you, and make it quick, I've a ship at eight.

lines.speaker: dock_foreman
lines.text: Berth nine. Four a week, every week, crated in-house so nobody on this dock ever sees what's inside one. Consignor's a shell with a post box, and the post box is up in the hills where there's nothing but a campus.

lines.speaker: dock_foreman
lines.text: Continuity Holdings. Same signature for eleven years and I have never once met a soul from there — no rep, no inspection, no complaint. Pay's on time, though. Pay's always on time, and that's rarer than you'd think.

lines.speaker: dock_foreman
lines.text: You lot from the future, then? No. Don't answer that. Everyone on this dock is from somewhere they'd rather not discuss and it's worked out fine so far.
